newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan to import remodelled U.K. Primera.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to import remodelled U.K. Primera.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would start marketing its completely remodelled British-made Primera compact car in Japan from next spring.
The new Primera made its debut at the Paris Motor Show on October 1. Nissan, which has been importing the current model into Japan since October 1991, has sold 6,400 units in the country so far.
Nissan plans to sell 3,000 British-made Primeras in Japan annually, a Nissan spokeswoman said.
The new Primera features European styling and safety devices.
Nissan launched its British-made Primera 5-door hatchback and 4-door sedan in Europe last month with an annual sales target of 130,000 units.
